# watchpoint_workflow (Resource)

An alerting workflow: when an event matching `trigger` fires (and the optional `condition_json` matches), the `actions` run in order. Requires `alerts.manage`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Post to an incident webhook whenever a critical alert fires, at most once
# every 15 minutes.
resource "watchpoint_workflow" "page_on_critical" {
  name             = "Critical alerts to the incident bridge"
  trigger          = "alert.fired"
  cooldown_minutes = 15
  condition_json   = jsonencode({ severity = "Critical" })

  actions = [
    {
      action_type = "Webhook"
      config_json = jsonencode({ url = "https://hooks.example.com/incident-bridge" })
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Workflow name.
- `trigger` (String) Event that starts the workflow, for example `alert.fired`, `alert.resolved` or `incident.opened`.

### Optional

- `actions` (Attributes List) Actions run in list order. Always sent whole, so removing one deletes it. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--actions))
- `condition_json` (String) Optional JSON condition evaluated against the event before the actions run. Compared as JSON, so formatting differences do not show as drift.
- `cooldown_minutes` (Number) Minimum minutes between two runs of this workflow. Once set it can be changed but not cleared: the API reads an omitted value as unchanged.
- `description` (String) Optional description.
- `is_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the workflow runs. Defaults to `true`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Workflow ID.
- `updated_at` (String) Last-update timestamp (RFC 3339).

<a id="nestedatt--actions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `actions`

Required:

- `action_type` (String) One of `Slack`, `Webhook`, `PagerDuty`, `Teams`, `Email`, `TicketReply`.
- `config_json` (String) Action configuration as a JSON object (for example the webhook URL or Slack channel). Compared as JSON.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import watchpoint_workflow.page_on_critical wf_001
```
